proof_body:
by
  intro f a w _
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * a * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v)) a]
  congr 1
  funext v
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a w : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f (v + a) = Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * a * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v
